BiblicalUsage: Jishbach is Ishbah, an Israelite, a son of Ezra of Judah. In 1 Chronicles 4:17, Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ishbah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
